# aMaximum Construction

> Licensed and insured construction and renovation contractor serving Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area (GTA), Ontario, Canada. Services include deck building, fence installation, basement renovation, bathroom renovation, general contracting, handyman services, carpentry, demolition, interlocking, plumbing, painting, electrical, landscaping, and home renovation.

- Site: https://www.amaximumconstruction.com/
- Email: amaximumconstructioncorp@gmail.com
- Service area: Toronto, Richmond Hill, Vaughan, Markham, Mississauga, Oakville, Burlington, Aurora, Newmarket, King City, Bradford, Hamilton, North York, Scarborough, Etobicoke, East York, Concord, Woodbridge, Schomberg, Thornhill, Kleinburg, East Gwillimbury
